scrumMaster.text: Stepped into the role of the Scrum Master for a newly formed team, guiding them through agile methodologies and helping build a strong foundation for collaboration and delivery. Focused on fostering team cohesion and ensuring we stay on track to meet project goals efficiently.

softwareEngineer.title: Software Engineer
softwareEngineer.text: Jumped into the tech world as a software engineer, working on everything from front-end interfaces to backend development and APIs. Web development and design were my starting points — and are still some of my favorite areas to work in.

bachelor.title: Bachelor of Science
bachelor.text: I earned my Bachelor of Science in Computer Science from DHBW Karlsruhe in 2018. The program offered a solid mix of academic theory and hands-on experience, which helped me build a strong foundation in software development and problem-solving early on.

about.heading: A glimpse into my private life

dogTraining.title: Dog training
dogTraining.text: I regularly head out for training and hiking sessions with my dog, Mali — it's a great way for both of us to stay active and enjoy the outdoors together.

familyTime.title: Family Time
familyTime.text: In April, we welcomed our first child into the world, which has been an incredible and life-changing experience. These days, I'm prioritizing quality time with my wife and newborn daughter—it's a special chapter I'm really grateful to be present for

gaming.title: Gaming is my passion
gaming.text: I'm deeply passionate about competitive gaming—it's my go-to way to challenge myself and keep improving. There's always something new to learn, whether it's mastering a mechanic or figuring out smarter strategies. It keeps me on my toes and I love that.
